rows.label: qst650401_msg0002
rows.name:
I wonder what's wrong. We
should go talk to her.

rows.label: qst650401_msg0004
rows.name:
The three children went out to play
outside the village, but none of them
have come back.

rows.label: qst650401_msg0005
rows.name:
Is that Nascion, Arin, and
Alina you're talking about?

rows.label: qst650401_msg0007
rows.name: Are those the kids we spoke to before?

rows.label: qst650401_msg0009
rows.name:
That's worrying. We need to go look
for them right away!

rows.label: qst650401_msg0013
rows.name:
I, um... It's my husband, too...
He went to look for the kids and
never came back, either...

rows.label: qst650401_msg0016
rows.name:
We really need to go look for them
right away.

rows.label: qst650401_msg0017
rows.name:
Levchina-san, where did Nascion
and Raymon-san go, mo?

rows.label: qst650401_msg0018
rows.name:
The children said they were going to
play near Port Isheba, so they all
should have gone that way.

rows.label: qst650401_msg0019
rows.name:
Got it. It's just the
next island over.
